svg.text: One run of cmd/percentes, from schedule to report
internal/run/run.go (Execute), cmd/percentes/main.go. Solid arrows carry the load and its records; dashed arrows are side channels.
pacer and workers: dispatch at t_i
at T_inject; records armed, fire, expiry
the victim's pod IP and via the Service
target: Phase 0 kind with the mock; Phase 1 vLLM
fault at T_inject: the mock admin API;
in the binary, after run.Execute returns
request records, fire and expiry times, probe times, server samples, canary summary
percentes-campaign repeats this run N times (seed = base + i), evaluates G1 to G7 per run, and aggregates the per-run scalars
into campaign.json and campaign.txt. The client stream is authoritative; server metrics are explanatory (SPEC.md §2).
